steps.en: Manual notices can be recognised by their source for the report
steps.id: Notice manual dikenali dari sumbernya untuk masuk laporan
steps.why_en: Notices are picked by a source code set on the screen; bulk uploads carry the same code.
steps.why_id: Notice dipilih lewat kode sumber dari layar; bulk upload memakai kode yang sama.

steps.en: A summary report lists the manually created notices
steps.id: Ada laporan ringkasan berisi daftar notice yang dibuat manual
steps.why_en: The report exists but only on request for a chosen date range, not as a daily summary.
steps.why_id: Laporan ada tetapi hanya atas permintaan untuk rentang tanggal pilihan, bukan ringkasan harian.

steps.en: The report is produced automatically every day
steps.why_en: No daily schedule exists; the report is built only when someone presses Export.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada jadwal harian; laporan hanya dibuat saat seseorang menekan Export.

steps.en: The report is routed to the OIC dashboard
steps.why_en: The dashboard page is empty; the report sits in the Report menu and must be opened by hand.
steps.why_id: Halaman dashboard kosong; laporan ada di menu Report dan harus dibuka sendiri.

steps.en: The OIC can download the report to see the notice details
steps.id: OIC dapat mengunduh laporan untuk melihat detail notice
